items.title: Improve docs of DBCore
items.body:
Need help providing more samples and better flow documentation of the DBCore interface and all its methods and related interfaces. For a skilled developer, it is possible to lab with DBCore even based on the minimal docs we have now, by looking at existing middlewares and create a custom middleware.

There is a skelleton of docs around the DBCore interface right now that is not very easy to follow. It would be a great help for others if someone had the time to provide more samples. My wish would be to provide the docs with some samples of middlewares and link to the samples from the docs of [DBCore](https://dexie.org/docs/DBCore/DBCore), [Dexie.use()](https://dexie.org/docs/Dexie/Dexie.use()) and [DBCoreTable](https://dexie.org/docs/DBCore/DBCoreTable).

Related issue in dexiejs-web: https://github.com/dfahlander/dexie.js-web/issues/59

gemini.mentor:
## 1. What the issue is
Issue #1032 requests improvements to the documentation and sample code around DBCore, its methods, related interfaces, and middlewares. While DBCore has an initial structural implementation in Dexie, the documentation and usage examples (especially around custom middlewares) are sparse and hard to follow.

## 2. Where it's happening
The issue pertains to documentation and public interfaces/middlewares implemented in files such as `src/dbcore/virtual-index-middleware.ts:43-52` and referenced in `src/classes/dexie/dexie.ts:64-71`.

## 3. Impact
Better documentation, examples of custom middlewares, and clear links between `DBCore`, `Dexie.use()`, and `DBCoreTable` will help developers understand how to intercept and customize low-level database operations using DBCore middlewares.

## 4. Concept & code flow
DBCore acts as a low-level abstraction layer over IndexedDB (or other storage backends) in Dexie. Middlewares can intercept requests by wrapping `DBCore` objects and their table methods, as seen in `src/dbcore/virtual-index-middleware.ts:43-52`.

Call flow for middlewares:
`Dexie.use()` -> registers middleware -> `dbcore` execution stack -> `virtualIndexMiddleware` (`src/dbcore/virtual-index-middleware.ts:43`) -> underlying storage backend.

## 5. How to solve it
Provide clear code snippets demonstrating how to write a custom DBCore middleware and point out where these can be integrated via `Dexie.use()`.

## 6. Suggested fix
No core source code changes are required for this documentation issue, but documentation examples can be added.

## 7. How to test it
Test custom middlewares by registering them on a Dexie instance using `db.use()` and running queries to verify that the middleware intercepts the requested operations.

## 8. Raise the PR
- **Branch name**: `docs/improve-dbcore-docs-samples`
- **Conventional Commit message**: `docs: add samples and improve documentation guidance for DBCore middlewares`
- **PR title**: `Improve docs and samples of DBCore and middlewares (#1032)`
- **PR description**: `Closes #1032. Adds comprehensive samples and structural explanation of DBCore, DBCoreTable, and Dexie.use() middlewares.`
- **Comment to claim**: `I would love to help improve the DBCore documentation and provide clear middleware samples as requested! Working on this now.`
